title: Coloring Monomial Cayley Graphs: The One-Parameter Case
summary: How do algebraic relations among unit directions influence the chromatic number of the plane? We introduce monomial Cayley graphs as a framework for investigating this question, beginning with graphs whose allowed unit steps are signed powers of a single complex parameter. Transcendental parameters give bipartite graphs, while for roots of unity we determine both the chromatic and circular chromatic numbers.
